fact: MCIT's Decent Life phase one reports 1,180,723 buildings covered by fibre, 1,409 new cell sites built and 576 upgraded, and mobile coverage completed in 901 of 1,164 villages.

The Ministry of Planning reported that under Haya Karima phase one fibre-optic network had been extended to 409 villages and the first-phase villages had 371,600 internet subscribers, at end-December 2024.
